title: Proving Ground
scope: STUB. Exists to prove the level pipeline works end to end — that a second level loads, chains from the first, appears in the menu and passes the validator. The layout is deliberately plain and is not playtested content.
brief: One gap, one set of spikes, one flag.
camera_y_note: Pins the camera vertically, keeping the framing this greybox level was built and screenshotted with. Omit it and the camera follows the player, which is what a level with real height needs.
enemies_note: [x, ground_y] is a bandit; a third value picks the kind — "bandit" (the default), "mark" (white-tank LF2 fighter) or "hunter" (the bow-carrying archer, cut as a brawler). Hunter waits on the first platform near the spawn; Mark is met on the far platform after the gap. Two kinds, no two stacked.
